A professor and a farm worker were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The professor recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the farm worker started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who failed classes in high school?
A. The professor
B. The farm worker
C. Not known
